name: National Braai Index
headline: R280
blurb: A family Saturday fire this week, if you buy the basket below and nothing fancy.
note: These are latest-known example figures from public South African grocery catalogues and shelf listings in the week of 24–30 August 2026. Mid-range prices — not the deepest midweek special, not a butcher's quote, not a live scrape. Wood is left out on purpose: a bag of permitted braai wood swings wildly by province. Nothing here is for sale. There is no 'buy here'. A later updater should edit this file, not the HTML.

items.name: Boerewors, 1 kg
items.basis: Public supermarket listings for a typical thick beef-and-pork boerewors. Championship-style wors was listed around R109.99/kg; own-brand farmstyle sat near R90 on special and about R120 off it. We took R110 — a mid figure, legally ≥90% meat.

items.name: Pork loin chops, 1 kg
items.basis: Fresh pork loin / pork braai chops on public catalogues that week ran from about R65/kg on a deep bulk special to around R120/kg regular. We took R90, not the cheapest sticker in the flyer.

items.name: Chicken braai pack, 1 kg
items.basis: A typical 5 kg frozen chicken braai pack was listed at R399 — R79.80 a kilo. Rounded to R80 for one honest kilogram.

excluded: Braai wood (permitted suppliers; price is local)
Lamb, beef steak, snoek — those are a different Saturday
